note: The run plays in place on a loop (x and y all 0, no path); it only carries the fps the page puts in the Run fps box. The Rogue's eight frames are the six poses of one step (contact, early stance, mid stance, passing, push-off, flight) followed by the early and the mid stance again (1 2 3 4 5 6 2 3), the user's idea for a smoother loop; 12 fps gives a loop of 0.67 s. The six-frame version (11 fps) is kept in source/six_frame_version/.
